onboarding.title:
Bins out.
On time.
onboarding.body: Pickup reminders for your address in Vilnius district.
onboarding.featureReminder: Get a reminder the evening before
onboarding.disclaimer: Unofficial app made by volunteers. Dates come from the schedules published by UAB „Nemenčinės komunalininkas“ and may contain mistakes.

setup.locationHint: Search for your village or town.
setup.locationNone: Nothing found. Only places served by UAB „Nemenčinės komunalininkas“ are listed.
setup.manualLink: Can't find it? Pick schedule rows by hand
setup.streetHint: Pickup days in {{place}} depend on the street.
setup.housingHint: {{place}} has separate schedules for houses and apartment buildings.
setup.houseHint: Your own bin by the road
setup.chooseHint: Several rows mention {{place}}. Pick the one that includes your address.
setup.useLocationHint: Finds the nearest address. Your location never leaves your phone.
setup.foundStreetUnsure: Your location is approximate, so you'll confirm the street next.
setup.locationDenied: Location access is off. Search for your place below, or allow location in the phone's settings.
setup.locationUnavailable: Couldn't get your location. Search for your place below.
setup.locationOffline: Couldn't download the address list. Check your internet connection.
setup.locationFar: There's no address served by UAB „Nemenčinės komunalininkas“ near you. If you're not at home, search for your place below.
setup.locationServicesOff: Location is turned off on your phone. Turn it on and try again, or search for your place below.

select.title: {{kind}}: your area
select.hint: Search for your village, town or street, then pick the row that includes your address.
select.noResults: Nothing found. Try a shorter word, without the ending.
select.noDates: No exact dates in the schedule: {{note}}

home.nothingUpcoming: No upcoming pickups in the published schedule yet. We'll check for a new schedule automatically.
home.nothingForKind: No upcoming {{kind}} pickups in the published schedule.
home.placeMissing: Your place changed in the new schedule. Please choose it again.
home.choosePending: Tell us which {{kind}} schedule is yours.
home.noteOnly: {{kind}}: the schedule only says “{{note}}”, so we can't send reminders for it.
home.notificationsOff: Notifications are off, so you won't get reminders.
home.refreshFailed: Couldn't check for a new schedule. Showing the saved one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.disclaimer: This app is provided free of charge, as is, without any warranty. The authors are not responsible for missed or wrong reminders, or for any consequences of relying on them. It is not affiliated with UAB „Nemenčinės komunalininkas“.

notifications.refreshBody: Open the app so it can load the next schedule.

errors.loadFailed: Couldn't load the schedule. Check your internet connection.
errors.unsupported: The schedule format has changed. Please update the app.

feedback.title: Help & feedback
feedback.githubNote: Opens a form on GitHub (a free account is needed). Nothing is sent until you submit it.
feedback.wrongDates: Dates look wrong? Let us know

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: The app ran into an unexpected error. Try again, or report it so we can fix it.
crash.lastTitle: The app closed unexpectedly last time. Would you like to report it? The report contains technical details only.
